title: Dhaka, Ankara discuss FTA plans, more Turkish investment in Bangladesh
content:
Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan recently discussed with his Bangladesh counterpart Khalilur Rahman a possible FTA or a preferential trade agreement and increased Turkish investment in sectors like textiles.
Dhaka invited Turkish businesses to invest in Bangladesh's private and special economic zones and offered support for establishing a dedicated Turkish special economic zone in the country.

title: India, US in course to execute 1st tranche of trade pact by mid-July
content:
After talks in New Delhi, India and the US said they are in the course to execute the first tranche of a bilateral trade pact by mid-July.
Most aspects have been finalised, Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal, who met the US team, indicated.
However, key sticking points, including US tariff proposals and India's push for relief from actions related to Section 301 probes, stay unresolved.

title: Why Bangladesh RMG exporters feel April data needs July reality check
content:
Bangladesh’s export earnings surged 32.92 per cent year on year in April, crossing the $4 billion mark, with apparel exports rising 31.21 per cent. 
However, exporters estimate actual growth at around 8–10 per cent, attributing the jump largely to delayed shipments after Eid disruptions.  
Industry stakeholders believe the true export trend will become clearer by July 2026.

title: Vietnam’s textile, garment exports reach $15.1 bn in January-May
content:
Vietnam’s textile and garment exports (excluding yarn and fibre) edged up 0.4 per cent year-on-year to $15.13 billion during January-May 2026, while yarn exports rose 8.7 per cent to $1.89 billion.
Cotton imports fell 6.3 per cent in value despite higher volumes, and fabric imports eased 0.5 per cent.
The country is targeting $50 billion in textile, garment, and yarn exports in 2026.
